lines.text: Joab struck down 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and David says God has rejected them.
David says God has shaken the land and torn it open, and made His people drink wine that staggers them.
God raised a banner so those who fear Him may flee the sword, and David asks Him to save us.
God speaks from His sanctuary, saying Ephraim is His helmet, Judah is His scepter, and Moab is His washbasin.
David asks who will lead him to Edom, says the help of angels is worthless, and God will trample enemies.
